name: Omphalos
description: The navel stone: a dome that flattens as the ground runs away from it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; bottom: 6%; width: 88%; height: @calc(88 - 66 * @sqrt(@abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * @abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) + @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y) * @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y)))%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
